0.9.140.title: Compass Beta 0.9.140
0.9.140.intro: Your ratings now shape what Discover suggests, binge-watching keeps the same release from one episode to the next, and adult addons can no longer be shown.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Rate a title 8 or higher and Discover suggests more like it. Rate it 4 or lower and it suggests less.
New installs keep the same source when the next episode starts, so quality and release group stay consistent through a series.
Adult addons can no longer be shown. Adult content is always hidden.
Song lyrics can now be translated into your language, with the original line kept above the translation.
Game logos that failed to load now come back instead of staying missing.
The music bar no longer opens by itself when Compass starts. It appears once you play something.

sections.heading: Discover
items: Your ratings now teach Discover what you like. A rating of 8 or more counts as a thumbs up and a rating of 4 or less as a thumbs down.
Ratings between 5 and 7 are treated as neutral and change nothing.

This works for titles whose page you have opened in Compass. Ratings imported in bulk from Trakt, IMDb and other services do not change your suggestions, so an import cannot drown out what you actually watch.
Rating still works offline: your taste updates on this device even if saving the rating to your account fails.

sections.heading: Playback
items: Keep same source on next episode is now on by default for new installs. When the next episode auto-plays, Compass keeps the release you were just watching and falls back to the best stream if it is not available.
If you already chose a setting, it is kept. You can change it any time in Settings, Player, Play mode.

sections.heading: Addons
items: Removed the Adult button, the age check and the adult category from the Addons room. Adult addons are no longer listed in the catalog or spotlight.
Removed Hide adult content from Settings, Library, because it can no longer be turned off. A synced profile cannot switch it off either.

sections.heading: Games
items: Game logos that failed to load once now retry instead of staying missing until you restart Compass.
The game page now uses the current Steam library logo first, the same one the browse pages show, and falls back to the older logo only if it is missing.
The seasonal showcase now uses the corrected publisher logos, and a logo no longer carries over from the previous game.
Small emblem logos no longer hide the game name on the game page.

sections.heading: Music
items: Lyrics can now be translated. Turn on Translate lyrics in the lyrics view or Karaoke and pick a language. The original line stays on screen with the translation under it, and the timing is unchanged. It is off by default and uses your AI key from Settings if you have one, otherwise a free online translator.

Compass now shares the artist, album, cover and playback time of the current song with Windows media controls, so tools such as WebNowPlaying and Rainmeter skins can show them. WebNowPlaying has no lyrics support, so lyrics are not shared.
